manifest.description: Diagnose Rust async or runtime-bound state captured into tasks, closures, globals, or long-lived structs with the wrong lifecycle.
when_to_use: background tasks, channels, runtime handles, or locks hide ownership and shutdown obligations
Send/Sync or borrow facts are legal but runtime lifecycle ownership is unclear
a correction plan needs PD-manual cancellation, channel, task, or runtime-owner slices
anti_patterns: do not use for borrow-checker errors without a lifecycle claim
do not use for Arc<Mutex<T>> counts alone
do not imply a shipped atom handles cancellation or task ownership directly
